adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb` the throttle (`retrieved_recently?`) sets the Redis key via `setnx`/`expire` before `perform_retrieve` runs, and `retrieve` skips `perform_retrieve` when `retrieved_recently?` returns true. So if `perform_retrieve`/`fetch_http` raises or fails to create a `TopicEmbed`, subsequent enqueued `RetrieveTopic` jobs (triggered by the embed `loading` page reloads) will be throttled for up to 60s even though nothing was successfully retrieved. However, the diff doesn’t show this causing a permanent failure (“never shows up”): the key expires after 60s and retries can resume, so it’s a robustness/UX concern rather than a clearly verifiable functional defect.
